servers.name: mcp-local-rag
servers.description: 易于设置的本地 RAG 服务器，配置最少

requiredEnv.name: BASE_DIR
requiredEnv.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory). Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

requiredEnv.name: BASE_DIRS
requiredEnv.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.

requiredEnv.name: DB_PATH
requiredEnv.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

requiredEnv.name: CACHE_DIR
requiredEnv.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

requiredEnv.name: HF_ENDPOINT
requiredEnv.description: Hugging Face model download endpoint. Set this to a mirror URL when direct downloads are blocked (defaults to https://huggingface.co).

requiredEnv.name: MODEL_NAME
requiredEnv.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

requiredEnv.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
requiredEnv.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

requiredEnv.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
requiredEnv.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

requiredEnv.name: RAG_GROUPING
requiredEnv.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

requiredEnv.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
requiredEnv.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

requiredEnv.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
requiredEnv.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

requiredEnv.name: STORE_IMAGES
requiredEnv.description: Store supported PDF and DOCX images during ingestion and return them with matched chunks (defaults to false).

requiredEnv.name: RAG_DEVICE
requiredEnv.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

requiredEnv.name: RAG_DTYPE
requiredEnv.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

requiredEnv.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
requiredEnv.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

requiredEnv.name: RAG_RERANK_CMD
requiredEnv.description: External reranker command template. Use {query} and {top} for query text and result count; unset disables reranking.

requiredEnv.name: RAG_RERANK_TIMEOUT_MS
requiredEnv.description: Time budget per rerank call in milliseconds (100-600000, defaults to 10000). On timeout the spawned command is killed and the pre-rerank ordering is returned.

requiredEnv.description: Language for client error messages: 'en' for English, otherwise/unset is Korean (default).

requiredEnv.name: NCLOUD_RESPONSE_MAXBYTES
requiredEnv.description: Opt-in response-size guard for read-only tools. When set to a positive byte threshold, large read-only responses are truncated item-by-item to stay under it, adding 'truncated'/'suggestedPageSize' recovery hints. Unset/0 = guard off (response shape unchanged).

servers.name: Obsidian Brain
servers.description: Obsidian MCP 服务器：语义搜索、知识图谱和库编辑。不需要插件。

requiredEnv.name: VAULT_PATH
requiredEnv.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault (or any folder of .md files).

requiredEnv.name: DATA_DIR
requiredEnv.description: Where to store the SQLite index + embedding cache. Defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/obsidian-brain or ~/.local/share/obsidian-brain.

requiredEnv.name: EMBEDDING_PRESET
requiredEnv.description: Preset name: english (default, bge-small-en-v1.5), english-fast, english-quality, multilingual, multilingual-quality, multilingual-ollama. Ignored when EMBEDDING_MODEL is set.

requiredEnv.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
requiredEnv.description: Power-user override: any transformers.js checkpoint or Ollama model id. Takes precedence over EMBEDDING_PRESET. Switching auto-reindexes.

requiredEnv.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
requiredEnv.description: Embedding backend. 'transformers' (local, default) or 'ollama' (requires a running Ollama server).

requiredEnv.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
requiredEnv.description: Base URL of a local Ollama server. Only used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama.

requiredEnv.name: OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIM
requiredEnv.description: Override the embedding dimensionality when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama. If unset, the server probes the model on startup.

requiredEnv.name: OLLAMA_NUM_CTX
requiredEnv.description: Override Ollama's num_ctx for embed requests. Leave UNSET to let obsidian-brain auto-detect via `/api/show`'s `context_length` (e.g. nomic-embed-text=2048, bge-m3=8192, qwen3-embedding:0.6b=32 768). Setting this manually imposes a hard cap and may silently truncate longer inputs — see https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/14259. Ollama's own default is 2048 which truncates for any model trained on a larger context. See also https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/7008. Fallback when both env is unset AND /api/show is unreachable: 8192.

requiredEnv.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL
requiredEnv.description: Auto-pull the configured Ollama model when /api/show returns 404 (model not present). Default ON — choosing an Ollama-backed preset is implicit consent to download its model. Streams /api/pull progress to stderr. Set to '0' to disable auto-pull entirely (master kill-switch) and fall back to the actionable error path (`HTTP 404 — try: ollama pull <model>`).

requiredEnv.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_BYOM_AUTO_PULL
requiredEnv.description: Opt-in to auto-pull for BYOM (custom EMBEDDING_MODEL) Ollama models OUTSIDE Ollama's official `library/` namespace. Default OFF — third-party models (e.g. `user/custom-fork`, `myregistry.com/team/model`) require this env var to be set to `1` before they will auto-pull, to prevent silent downloads of arbitrary user-named artifacts. Preset-known models (via EMBEDDING_PRESET) and bare model ids in the official library (e.g. `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`, `library/llama3:8b`) continue to auto-pull by default per the existing OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL behavior.

requiredEnv.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH
requiredEnv.description: Set to '1' to disable the live chokidar file watcher. Useful on SMB/NFS vaults where FSEvents/inotify don't fire reliably — fall back to running `obsidian-brain index` on a schedule (launchd/systemd).

requiredEnv.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_CATCHUP
requiredEnv.description: Set to '1' to skip the startup catchup reindex pass that picks up edits made while the server was down. The live file watcher still starts (via OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH=1 to disable that separately), and first-time indexing on an empty DB is unaffected — this knob only governs the post-restart `enqueueBackgroundReindex` walk.

requiredEnv.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS
requiredEnv.description: Per-file reindex debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds.

requiredEnv.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_COMMUNITY_DEBOUNCE_MS
requiredEnv.description: Graph-wide community-detection (Louvain) debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds. Louvain is the only expensive op — batching it prevents per-edit CPU spikes.

requiredEnv.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS
requiredEnv.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Tools exceeding this return an MCP error instead of hanging.

requiredEnv.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_MAX_CHUNK_TOKENS
requiredEnv.description: Override the adaptive chunk-size budget (in tokens). When set, this beats the capacity probed from the model's tokenizer or Ollama /api/show. Use for debugging or for models with stale tokenizer configs.

requiredEnv.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_CONFIG_DIR
requiredEnv.description: Override the per-user config directory where obsidian-brain stores model overrides (`model-overrides.json`) and the user-fetched seed (`seed-models.json`). Default is `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/obsidian-brain` on macOS/Linux (or `~/.config/obsidian-brain`) and `%APPDATA%/obsidian-brain` on Windows. Both files survive `npm update obsidian-brain` because they live outside the package.

requiredEnv.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_DEBUG
requiredEnv.description: Set to "1" to print a verbose synchronous startup trace to stderr — every preflight, createContext, server.connect, and shutdown step is logged with a monotonic timestamp. The LAST line before any silent failure tells you exactly which step the server reached. No-op when unset (no overhead). Use to diagnose silent-crash failure modes.

requiredEnv.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_LOG_FORMAT
requiredEnv.description: Set to 'ndjson' for one-JSON-object-per-line stderr output (timestamp + level + message + structured fields). Default is human-readable plain text (`obsidian-brain: <message>`). Useful for piping logs into aggregators (Datadog, Loki, Vector, journald) that index structured fields.

requiredEnv.description: Base URL of the %alias permit server — the separate service that prices a %name and co-signs the claim transaction. Defaults to XETE_SERVER_URL. Must be https:// unless the host is loopback. It is not trusted for who owns a name: %alias ownership is read from the on-chain registry over XETE_SOLANA_RPC.

requiredEnv.name: XETE_SOLANA_RPC
requiredEnv.description: Solana RPC used to read the %alias registry, the source of truth for which wallet a %name points to. Defaults to https://solana-rpc.publicnode.com (api.mainnet-beta throttles reads).

requiredEnv.name: XETE_SPEND_MAX_LAMPORTS
requiredEnv.description: Client-side spend limit: the most a single transaction may cost, in lamports. Enforced before anything is signed. Unset means the conservative default, never unlimited.

requiredEnv.name: XETE_SPEND_WINDOW_LAMPORTS
requiredEnv.description: Client-side spend limit: the most that may be spent in total, in lamports, inside the rolling window. Unset means the conservative default, never unlimited.

requiredEnv.name: XETE_SPEND_WINDOW_SECONDS
requiredEnv.description: Length in seconds of the rolling window that XETE_SPEND_WINDOW_LAMPORTS applies to. Spending is recorded on disk, so the window survives a restart.

requiredEnv.name: XETE_SPEND_FLOOR_LAMPORTS
requiredEnv.description: Minimum charged against the spend budget for any on-chain action, covering the account rent and network fees that a quoted price excludes.

requiredEnv.name: XETE_SPEND_LEDGER
requiredEnv.description: Where spending is recorded so the rolling window survives a restart. Defaults to ~/.xete/spend-ledger.json; the identity keystore alongside it is never touched.

servers.name: 智能体 Billboard
servers.description: 阅读并发布到 Solana 上的智能体 Billboard，其中包含代码中的支出限制和推理日志。

requiredEnv.name: BILLBOARD_SANDBOX
requiredEnv.description: true or 1: rehearse against a simulated board with an ephemeral wallet generated at start-up. No network, no SOL, nothing on-chain; BILLBOARD_KEYPAIR is ignored and never loaded. false or 0 (default): the real board. No other value is accepted.

requiredEnv.name: BILLBOARD_SANDBOX_SCENARIO
requiredEnv.description: Which simulated board the sandbox starts from: default (a previous poster holding at 0.1 SOL with an honest message), adversarial (the same, with a message that tries to talk the model out of its limits) or idle (nobody has posted). Ignored unless BILLBOARD_SANDBOX is on.

requiredEnv.name: BILLBOARD_KEYPAIR
requiredEnv.description: Point this at the wallet your agent already uses. Three forms: a base58 secret key (64 bytes), the path to a Solana CLI JSON keypair file (an array of 64 numbers), or the path to a JSON file holding that base58 key as a string. Unset = read-only mode: reads and dry runs work, nothing can be signed.

requiredEnv.name: MAX_BID_SOL
requiredEnv.description: Largest single bid the server will sign, in SOL. Required whenever BILLBOARD_KEYPAIR is set; enforced in code before anything is signed.

requiredEnv.name: DAILY_CAP_SOL
requiredEnv.description: Total gross bids allowed per rolling 24 hours, in SOL. Defaults to MAX_BID_SOL. Refunds do not restore the allowance.

requiredEnv.name: AUTO_BID
requiredEnv.description: false (default): write tools return a proposal and only approve_proposal signs. true: write tools sign directly, still inside the limits.

requiredEnv.name: PROPOSAL_TTL_MIN
requiredEnv.description: How long a proposal stays open before it expires, in whole minutes (1-1440). Default 60. Each write tool has one open proposal at a time; proposing again supersedes the older one.

requiredEnv.name: INTENT_PATH
requiredEnv.description: Operator-written intent file, returned verbatim in every read_billboard response. A missing file is not an error.

requiredEnv.name: HISTORY_URL
requiredEnv.description: Optional URL of a site-published history.json. Unset, unreachable or disagreeing with the chain = flip history derived on-chain.

requiredEnv.name: RPC_URL
requiredEnv.description: Solana JSON-RPC endpoint.

requiredEnv.name: RPC_WS_URL
requiredEnv.description: Websocket endpoint for account-change subscriptions. Defaults to RPC_URL with https replaced by wss.

requiredEnv.name: ACTIVITY_LOG_PATH
requiredEnv.description: Append-only JSONL log of every proposal, approval, refusal and transaction, each with the agent's reasoning.

requiredEnv.name: STATE_PATH
requiredEnv.description: Where the server remembers what this wallet last read, so a fresh process (a scheduled wake) still sees changes and outbids since the previous one. One working directory per agent. Ignored in the sandbox, which persists nothing.

requiredEnv.name: URL2MD_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
requiredEnv.description: Path to a file holding the 0x-prefixed private key of a wallet with USDC on Base. Preferred over URL2MD_PRIVATE_KEY: a path is not a secret, and a key on a command line is visible to every process on the machine. One of the two key variables is required.

requiredEnv.name: URL2MD_PRIVATE_KEY
requiredEnv.description: The key itself: 0x followed by 64 hex characters. Use URL2MD_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE instead where you can. One of the two key variables is required.

requiredEnv.name: URL2MD_MAX_PRICE_USD
requiredEnv.description: The most this server will commit for one call, in USD, across every payment round of that call. A tolled page takes two rounds and this ceiling covers both.

requiredEnv.name: URL2MD_MAX_SPEND_USD
requiredEnv.description: The most this server will commit in total for as long as the process runs. Restarting resets it.

requiredEnv.name: URL2MD_BASE_URL
requiredEnv.description: The url2md deployment to call. Must be https (only a loopback address may be plain http), because this is the origin every 402 is checked against.

requiredEnv.name: URL2MD_TIMEOUT_MS
requiredEnv.description: How long to wait for one conversion, in milliseconds. The default covers the service's own worst case: 20 s of fetching plus 55 s of headless render. Do not lower it to 30 s — that is the navigation timeout inside the browser, and on a page that needed a browser your payment has already settled by the time the render starts.
